blocks.content:
Dashboards are saved pages of panels that give your team an at-a-glance view of related information. In this milestone, you navigate to the Dashboards area and browse a dashboard to see how panels are arranged.

To navigate to Dashboards, complete the following steps:

1. In the Grafana Cloud main menu, click **Dashboards**.
   The Dashboards page opens, showing a list of available dashboards and folders.
2. Browse the list and click any dashboard to open it.
   You see a page with one or more panels, each displaying data as a chart, graph, or number.
3. Notice how panels are arranged on the page. Each panel shows data from a query, displayed as a visualization.

You've now seen what a dashboard looks like: a saved page of panels, each showing data in a different visual format.

In the next milestone, you navigate to Explore.
